name: Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP)
description: Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) is a proprietary protocol developed by Microsoft Corporation which provides a user with a graphical interface to connect to another computer over a network connection.

subtechniques.name: GPU RDP
subtechniques.description: RDP with GPU allows users to remotely connect to a computer with a GPU and leverage its processing power to accelerate graphic-intensive applications, such as Android emulator, video rendering, 3D modeling, game streaming, AI training and deep learning.

procedures.name: AmazingRDP Graphic Card
procedures.description: AmazingRDP’s Graphic Card RDP is a service which allows one to emulate Android applications. Amazingrdp.com/graphic-card-rdp/

procedures.name: Remmina
procedures.description: Free and open source remote desktop client for Linux supporting RDP, VNC, SSH and other protocols. https://remmina.org/

procedures.name: RealVNC viewer
procedures.description: VNC remote desktop viewer for accessing remote infrastructure anonymously. https://www.realvnc.com/en/connect/download/viewer/linux/
